entities.name: dCTP deaminase
observations: The 178-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein Q9YFA8 from Aeropyrum pernix.
Curated annotation assigns EC 3.5.4.13 and dCTP deaminase activity.
Pfam detects the DCD domain (PF22769.2; residues 2-147) and a dUTPase-like domain (PF00692.25; residues 69-166).

entities.name: dCTP deamination
observations: Rhea RHEA:22680: dCTP + H2O + H(+) = dUTP + NH4(+).
This reaction converts the cytosine base of dCTP to uracil, releasing ammonia/ammonium.
The reaction is part of the dUTP route to dUMP in pyrimidine metabolism.

entities.name: Pyrimidine metabolism
observations: The enzyme participates in dUTP biosynthesis and the dUMP biosynthetic process via the dUTP route.
Curated GO terms include GO:0008829, GO:0006226, and GO:0006229.

entities.name: dCTP deaminase sequence properties
observations: The protein is 178 amino acids long with calculated molecular weight 19,652 Da and theoretical pI 8.60.
The sequence-derived charge at pH 7 is approximately +1.77; these are unmodified-protein estimates.
